create or replace package body fiscal_calendar as
  function year_of(p_date in date) return number is
  begin
    return extract(year from p_date) + case when extract(month from p_date) >= 7 then 1 else 0 end;
  end year_of;

  function quarter_of(p_date in date) return number is
  begin
    -- Fiscal year starts in July (Month 7).
    -- Q1: Jul, Aug, Sep (Months 7, 8, 9)
    -- Q2: Oct, Nov, Dec (Months 10, 11, 12)
    -- Q3: Jan, Feb, Mar (Months 1, 2, 3)
    -- Q4: Apr, May, Jun (Months 4, 5, 6)
    
    -- Adjust month to be 1-indexed relative to the fiscal year start (July=1, Aug=2, ..., Jun=12)
    -- If month is 1-6, add 7 to map it to 8-13.
    -- If month is 7-12, subtract 6 to map it to 1-6.
    
    -- A simpler way: map month 1..12 to fiscal month 1..12
    -- Fiscal Month = (Month + 5) mod 12 + 1
    -- e.g., July (7) -> (7+5) mod 12 + 1 = 12 mod 12 + 1 = 1
    -- e.g., Dec (12) -> (12+5) mod 12 + 1 = 17 mod 12 + 1 = 6
    -- e.g., Jan (1) -> (1+5) mod 12 + 1 = 6 mod 12 + 1 = 7 (Wait, this is wrong)
    
    -- Let's use the standard definition:
    -- Months 7, 8, 9 -> Q1
    -- Months 10, 11, 12 -> Q2
    -- Months 1, 2, 3 -> Q3
    -- Months 4, 5, 6 -> Q4
    
    if extract(month from p_date) >= 7 and extract(month from p_date) <= 9 then
      return 1; -- July, August, September
    elsif extract(month from p_date) >= 10 and extract(month from p_date) <= 12 then
      return 2; -- October, November, December
    elsif extract(month from p_date) >= 1 and extract(month from p_date) <= 3 then
      return 3; -- January, February, March
    else -- Months 4, 5, 6
      return 4; -- April, May, June
    end if;
  end quarter_of;
end fiscal_calendar;
